summary: F&M Bank Corp., the Virginia bank holding company for Farmers & Merchants Bank, filed an 8-K on November 4, 2026, announcing that its common stock was approved for listing on the NYSE American. Shares are expected to begin trading under the existing ticker FMBM on or about November 19, 2026, subject to continued compliance with exchange rules; shares remain on OTCQX through the prior market close. No terms, pricing, or advisors are stated. This is a routine exchange up-listing notice, not a special situation; watch for potential liquidity and index-eligibility effects.
